topic: Kyoto Protocol Flexibility Mechanisms
questionText:
Match the Kyoto Protocol market mechanism in List I with its operational definition in List II:

List I:
(A) Clean Development Mechanism (CDM)
(B) Joint Implementation (JI)
(C) International Emissions Trading (IET)
(D) Certified Emission Reduction (CER)

List II:
(I) Annex I country invests in emission reduction projects in a Non-Annex I developing country (Article 12)
(II) Annex I country invests in emission reduction projects in another Annex I country (Article 6)
(III) Trading of assigned amount units (AAUs) between Annex I countries with emissions targets (Article 17)
(IV) Standard unit issued under CDM representing one metric ton of CO2 equivalent reduced or sequestered
